work

One professional case study, and two personal builds that keep the design muscle active.

01
BMO App Redesign
Product DesigniOSFintech

BMO's mobile banking app felt legacy — dense screens, a dated visual language, and none of the polish people now expect from banking apps like Wealthsimple. I redesigned it end-to-end with a cleaner, more modern interface, focused on three core flows: checking in, moving money, and understanding where you stand.

  • Home — added quick-access buttons for Send, Transfer, Pay Bill, and Insights right on the dashboard, so the most common actions are one tap away instead of buried in menus.
  • Investments — a new dedicated page showing how accounts are performing, with a timeline graph so growth is visible at a glance instead of just a static balance.
  • Cards — a virtual view of every card, with balances, transaction history, limits, and bill payments all in one place.

About

I'm a UX/UI designer based in Toronto, Ontario, with an Honors Bachelor's in Computer Science from Sheridan College. I currently work as a Cloud Developer at BMO, building APIs on AWS — but my first real product design work happened back at Sheridan, prototyping and usability-testing a mobile app for a nonprofit client. Outside of work, I do photography, which is where a lot of my eye for composition and light actually comes from.

  • Real design process — usability testing, personas, and journey maps from client work, not just theory.
  • Full-stack fluency — years shipping production APIs on AWS, plus React and Swift.
  • A photographer's eye — composition, light, and framing from photography.
